lines: Oh, hello! You must be the new farmer.
I run the flower stall near the shop. Come by anytime.
Back again? The lilies are doing well this year.
Have you heard the news? Everyone in the village is whispering.
I would lock my door tonight, if I were you.
Shh! Keep your voice down. Did you hear that?
I keep my shutters closed after dark now.
Hmph. Another farmer. The last one did not stay long.
I did not see anything. Do you hear me? Nothing at all.
What are you doing out at this hour? Go home.
Ah, you must be the other newcomer. I arrived just a few days ago myself.
Have you tried the sweets they sell here? All imported, all sugar. Disgusting.
Back home we kept our own bees. Here, take this hive. I built it from spare boards.
Put it somewhere sunny, near the flowers, and the bees will do the rest. Trust me, I know what I am doing.
Found a spot for the hive yet? Somewhere with plenty of flowers nearby.
You will thank me later. Real honey is nothing like the town sweets.
Good spot! Now give the bees a few days.
They know their business better than we do.
Hm. I do not see many flowers around your hive.
Bees need blossoms to make honey. Maybe you should plant it near some flowers instead.
Take it back with your pickaxe and move it next to the lilies and azaleas. They will be much happier.
Is that the honey? Let me see... Hm. Much darker than what we make back home.
And the taste is sharper, heavier. Unusual.
But it is good! Good in its own way. Keep some for yourself.
Honey every few days. I should have brought bees to this valley sooner.
Oh, a new face. Welcome to the village.
I do not talk much, but I do know a lot about the valley. If you need help, just ask.
Be careful who you trust around here.
